items.title: Adolphe Alexander Interview, 1961-03-08
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Bill Russell; the name is only mentioned by the interviewer in the closing remarks.

ctx.x: I don't know. I don't know. I don't know him about his violin players. He used to play piano all the time. I know. He used to play piano all the time. But he used to play a little violin though. He used to play a little bit of all the instruments.

Yeah, all the instruments. I've heard him on violin. He's not bad on violin. He gets around all right on him. He used to play a little bit of all instruments.
